group_metadata.name: Tags
group_metadata.description: Danbooru style taggers, and moondream (VLM) based general item taggers.

moondream-2b-25-03.description: (Experimental) Moondream 2B Based Tagger. This tagger works for general items and has an open vocabulary as it is a VLM

moondream-2b-25-03-clothing.description: (Experimental) Moondream 2B Based Tagger prompted to only list items of clothing as tags. This tagger works for general items and has an open vocabulary as it is a VLM

group_metadata.name: Tag Matching
group_metadata.description: Matches your images to those uploaded to places like Danbooru and returns the tags associated with them.

danbooru.description: Finds your images and videos on Danbooru and downloads the tags. Ignores the confidence threshold.

danbooru-saucenao.description: Requires a SauceNAO API key, provided through the SAUCENAO_API_KEY environment variable or the api_key config option. Falls back to SauceNAO if it can't find your exact image on Danbooru. Finds your images and videos on Danbooru and downloads the tags. Applies the confidence threshold to the SauceNAO similarity level.

group_metadata.name: OCR
group_metadata.description: Extract text from images, videos, and documents through OCR using DocTR or EasyOCR.

dots_ocr.description: DotsOCR - rednote-hilab/dots.ocr (FlashAttention 2 is required for this model!)

easyocr_standard_en.description: (Recommended) EasyOCR - English Text, Standard Recog Network

easyocr_standard_en_ja.description: (Recommended) EasyOCR - English/Japanese Text, Standard Recog Network

easyocr_standard_en_ch_sim.description: (Recommended) EasyOCR - English/Chinese Simplified Text, Standard Recog Network

group_metadata.name: Florence 2
group_metadata.description: Image captioning and OCR through Microsoft's Florence2 models

msft_large-more-detailed.description: (Detailed Captioning) (Size: Large) Microsoft's original Florence 2 Large Model

msft_large-caption.description: (Captioning) (Size: Large) Microsoft's original Florence 2 Large Model

msft_large-detailed.description: (Medium Detail Captioning) (Size: Large)  Microsoft's original Florence 2 Large Model

msft_large-ocr.description: (OCR) (Size: Large) (Recommended)  Microsoft's original Florence 2 Large Model

group_metadata.name: VLMs
group_metadata.description: Image captioning and OCR through Vision-Language Models like Moondream 2B.

moondream-2b-25-03-tags.description: (Recommended) Moondream 2B (v2025/03) captioning model that outputs a list of keywords for each image

group_metadata.name: Text Embeddings
group_metadata.description: Generate Text Embeddings from extracted text using Sentence Transformers. Enables semantic text search. This will generate embeddings for text already extracted by other models such as Whisper Speech-to-Text, or OCR. If you haven't run those models yet, you should do so first.

jina-embeddings-v3-api.description: Not local (API-based). You must set the JINA_API_KEY env var (or the api_key config option) before using this model. jina-embeddings-v3 is a multilingual multi-task text embedding model designed for a variety of NLP applications.

group_metadata.name: Whisper Speech-to-Text
group_metadata.description: Extract text from audio using OpenAI's Whisper model

group_metadata.name: CLIP Image Embeddings
group_metadata.description: Generate Image Embeddings using OpenAI's CLIP model for semantic image search

ViT-H-14-378-quickgelu_dfn5b.description: (Recommended) ViT-H-14 (378px) model pretrained on DFN5B. Has highest ImageNet 1K 0-shot accuracy (84.4%).

qwen3-vl-embedding-8b.description: Qwen3-VL Embedding 8B (text+image) multimodal embedding model. Leads MMEB-V2 across natural images and visual documents. Heavier than CLIP (roughly 16 GB VRAM in bf16); consider smaller batch sizes.

qwen3-vl-embedding-2b.description: Qwen3-VL Embedding 2B (text+image) multimodal embedding model. Strong on visual documents/screenshots as well as natural images (MMEB-V2). Heavier than CLIP (roughly 4.5 GB VRAM in bf16); consider smaller batch sizes.

PE-Core-L-14-336_meta.description: Perception Encoder Core L/14 (336px) by Meta (2025). Outperforms ViT-H-14-378 (DFN5B) on retrieval benchmarks (COCO T2I R@1 57.1 vs 55.6) at ~1.3 GB VRAM in fp16 and roughly twice the speed. Note: 32-token text context, long queries are truncated.

PE-Core-bigG-14-448_meta.description: Perception Encoder Core bigG/14 (448px) by Meta (2025). The largest and strongest PE model (COCO T2I R@1 58.1), but very heavy: ~4.6 GB VRAM in fp16 for marginal benchmark gains over PE-Core-L.

ViT-B-16-SigLIP2-384_webli.description: SigLIP 2 B/16 (384px) by Google (2025). Nearly matches ViT-H-14-378 (DFN5B) retrieval quality (COCO T2I R@1 54.6 vs 55.6) at ~0.75 GB VRAM in fp16. Multilingual. Recommended if resources are limited.

apple_MobileCLIP-B-LT.description: MobileCLIP-B-LT model by Apple. Great 0-shot accuracy (77.2%) for the size. Recommended if resources are limited.

apple_MobileCLIP-S2.description: MobileCLIP-S2-LT model by Apple. Good 0-shot accuracy (74.4%) for the size. Recommended if resources are limited.

apple_MobileCLIP-S1.description: MobileCLIP-S1-LT model by Apple. Adequate 0-shot accuracy (72.6%) for the size. Recommended if resources are very limited.

nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2.description: NVIDIA Llama Nemotron Embed VL 1B v2: unified multimodal embedder (Llama 3.2 1B + SigLIP2 vision, ~1.7B params, 2048-dim, ~3.2 GB VRAM in bf16). Tiles images at native aspect ratio. Trained for visual document retrieval (screenshots, PDF pages, charts); natural image/art retrieval quality is unproven. Asymmetric retriever: text is always embedded as a search query, so use it for image embeddings only and do not pair it with a CLIP Text Embeddings (tclip) run.

jina-clip-v2-api.description: Not local (API-based). You must set the JINA_API_KEY env var (or the api_key config option) before using this model. jina-clip-v2 is a general-purpose multilingual multimodal embedding model for text & images.

ViT-B-32-256_datacomp_s34b_b86k.description: ViT-B-32-256 model pretrained on DataComp S34B (b86k). ViT-B-32 are the least resource intensive ViT model type.

ViT-B-32_datacomp_xl_s13b_b90k.description: ViT-B-32 model pretrained on DataComp XL (s13b_b90k). ViT-B-32 are the least resource intensive ViT model type.

ViT-g-14_laion2b_s34b_b88k.description: ViT-g-14 model pretrained on LAION2B (s34b_b88k). ViT-G-14 are the largest ViT model type, however not currently the best performing.

ViT-L-14_openai.description: Original CLIP model trained by OpenAI

ViT-B-32_openai.description: ViT-B-32 model trained by OpenAI. ViT-B-32 are the least resource intensive ViT model type.

coca_ViT-B-32_mscoco_finetuned_laion2b_s.description: CoCa ViT-B-32 model fine-tuned on MSCOCO

coca_ViT-L-14_mscoco_finetuned_laion2b_s.description: CoCa ViT-L-14 model fine-tuned on MSCOCO

convnext_xxlarge_laion2b_s34b_b82k_augre.description: ConvNeXT xxlarge model pretrained on LAION2B (s34b_b82k_augreg_soup)

convnext_large_d_320_laion2b_s29b_b131k_.description: ConvNeXT large d 320 model pretrained on LAION2B (s29b_b131k_ft_soup)

convnext_base_w_320_laion_aesthetic_s13b.description: ConvNeXT base wide 320 model pretrained on LAION Aesthetic (s13b_b82k_augreg)

convnext_base_w_laion2b_s13b_b82k_augreg.description: ConvNeXT base wide model pretrained on LAION2B (s13b_b82k_augreg)

convnext_base_laion400m_s13b_b51k.description: ConvNeXT base model pretrained on LAION400M (s13b_b51k)

mrzjy_GenshinImpact-ViT-SO400M-14_SigLIP.description: A simple open-sourced SigLIP model fine-tuned on Genshin Impact's image-text pairs.

mrzjy_GenshinImpact-CLIP-ViT-B-16-laion2.description: Much smaller variant of the ViT-SO400M-14 size model. A simple and small-size open-sourced CLIP model fine-tuned on Genshin Impact's image-text pairs.

marqo-fashionCLIP.description: Marqo-FashionCLIP leverages Generalised Contrastive Learning (GCL) which allows the model to be trained on not just text descriptions but also categories, style, colors, materials, keywords and fine-details to provide highly relevant search results on fashion products. The model was fine-tuned from ViT-B-16 (laion2b_s34b_b88k).

marqo-fashionSigLIP.description: Marqo-FashionSigLIP leverages Generalised Contrastive Learning (GCL) which allows the model to be trained on not just text descriptions but also categories, style, colors, materials, keywords and fine-details to provide highly relevant search results on fashion products. The model was fine-tuned from ViT-B-16-SigLIP (webli).

open-clip-vit-h-nsfw-finetune.description: CLIP model finetuned for NSFW detection.

imageomics_bioclip.description: BioCLIP is a foundation model for the tree of life, built using CLIP architecture as a vision model for general organismal biology. It is trained on TreeOfLife-10M, our specially-created dataset covering over 450K taxa--the most biologically diverse ML-ready dataset available to date. Through rigorous benchmarking on a diverse set of fine-grained biological classification tasks, BioCLIP consistently outperformed existing baselines by 16% to 17% absolute. Through intrinsic evaluation, we found that BioCLIP learned a hierarchical representation aligned to the tree of life, which demonstrates its potential for robust generalizability.

microsoft_BiomedCLIP-PubMedBERT_256-vit_.description: BiomedCLIP is a biomedical vision-language foundation model that is pretrained on PMC-15M, a dataset of 15 million figure-caption pairs extracted from biomedical research articles in PubMed Central, using contrastive learning. It uses PubMedBERT as the text encoder and Vision Transformer as the image encoder, with domain-specific adaptations. It can perform various vision-language processing (VLP) tasks such as cross-modal retrieval, image classification, and visual question answering.

group_metadata.name: CLIP Text Embeddings
group_metadata.description: Generate Text Embeddings from extracted text using OpenAI's CLIP model. This is exclusively meant for cross-modal item similarity search. For semantic text search, use the `Text Embeddings` model group. This will generate embeddings for text already extracted by other models such as Whisper Speech-to-Text, or OCR. If you haven't run those models yet, you should do so first.

group_metadata.name: CLAP Audio Embeddings
group_metadata.description: (Experimental) Generate Audio Embeddings using CLAP models for semantic audio search.

larger_clap_music.description: This is an improved CLAP checkpoint, specifically trained on music

larger_clap_music_and_speech.description: This is an improved CLAP checkpoint, specifically trained on music and speech.

larger_clap_general.description: This is an improved CLAP checkpoint, specifically trained on general audio, music and speech.

group_metadata.name: Calibration protocol fixtures
group_metadata.description: Fault-injection fixtures for the batch-calibration test protocol: deterministic OOM on the second batch, batch-1 OOM, non-OOM merged-batch failure, and worker death on demand. Not a real model.

oom_second_batch_cuda.description: OOMs once, on the second GPU batch (CUDA-touching, priced)

failbatch_cuda.description: Fails merged batches with a non-OOM error (CUDA-touching, priced)

failbatch_oomtext_cuda.description: Non-OOM merged-batch failure whose text contains 'out of memory' (B11)

oom_timed_cuda.description: Batch-1 OOM for 120 s after load, then healthy (CUDA-touching, priced)

oom_second_batch_cpu.description: OOMs on the second GPU batch (torch-free)

failbatch_cpu.description: Fails merged batches with a non-OOM error (torch-free)

hang_trim_cuda.description: Ignores a trim for 70 s, past the 60 s TRIM_DEADLINE (B17)
